questions.why: The answer is taken directly from the passage.

questions.why: The passage says a high cholesterol level can cause a heart attack.

questions.lesson: فهم القطعة والإجابة على الأسئلة | Reading Comprehension

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *She was ill, ____ she took some medicine.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Taking medicine is the result of being ill, so 'so'.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ I cleaned my room, my sister didn't.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: 'Whereas' compares two different people: I did, my sister didn't.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ I was sick, I did my homework.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Being sick and still doing homework are contrasting ideas: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ she has two cars, she can't drive.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Having cars but not driving is a contrast: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ my mother prefers city life, my father doesn't.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: 'Whereas' compares two people with different preferences.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ he is rich, he is unhappy.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Rich and unhappy are contrasting ideas: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *They cancelled the trip ____ the weather was bad.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Bad weather is the reason: because.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ the journey was long, it was interesting.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Long but interesting is a contrast: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *He walks to work ____ he has two cars.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Walking while having cars is a contrast: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *That boy ate 2 sandwiches and 3 pieces of pizza ____.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: 'As well' comes at the end of the sentence to add information.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *He was punished ____ he lied.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Lying is the reason for the punishment: because.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ she prepared the food, she didn't eat it.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Preparing food but not eating it is a contrast: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *I am studying biology ____ physics.*
questions.topic: As well as in the middle
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: 'As well as' joins two things in the middle of the sentence.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ the restaurant was crowded, they found a table.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: Crowded but they found a table is a contrast: although.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *Omar is diligent and polite. ____, he is patient.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: 'Furthermore' adds another good quality at the start of a new sentence.

questions.q: Choose the suitable linking word: *____ my mother, I like listening to radio programmes — we both enjoy them.*
questions.lesson: Use the suitable linking words | استخدام أدوات الربط المناسبة
questions.why: 'We both enjoy them' shows they are the same, so 'Like'.
